record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.original_question: Find complete multipartite graphs G, other than the family described in Corollary 4.2, such that ψ_q(G) = 1.

evidence.quote: 3. Can you ﬁnd complete multipartite graphs G other than those of Corollary 4.2 such that ψq(G) = 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple graph. For a vertex v ∈ V, let N[v] denote the closed neighborhood of v, that is, {v} together with all vertices adjacent to v. A partition π = {V_1, V_2, …, V_k} of V into k nonempty color classes is called a quorum coloring of G if, for every vertex v ∈ V, at least half of the vertices of N[v] lie in the same color class as v; equivalently, |N[v] ∩ V_{c(v)}| ≥ |N[v]|/2, where c(v) is the index of the class containing v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is defined as the maximum number of classes in any quorum coloring of G.

A complete multipartite graph K_{n_1, n_2, …, n_r} (with r ≥ 2 and each n_i ≥ 1) is the graph whose vertex set is partitioned into r independent sets ("parts") of sizes n_1, …, n_r, with two vertices adjacent if and only if they lie in different parts.

Problem. Characterize, or exhibit explicit infinite families of, complete multipartite graphs G = K_{n_1, n_2, …, n_r} satisfying ψ_q(G) = 1 (i.e., for which the only quorum coloring is the trivial one using a single color class), beyond the already-known family consisting of those complete multipartite graphs whose part-size sequence (n_1, …, n_r) satisfies the previously identified sufficient condition of having Σ n_i odd and each part of size at most ⌈(Σ n_i)/2⌉ in the appropriate sense.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding additional complete multipartite graphs G with ψ_q(G) = 1 beyond a specific known family is posed as one of the open questions in work on quorum colorings. Subsequent literature on quorum colorings (including a 2018 paper on open problems and a 2023 arXiv paper on linear-time quorum coloring) does not appear to contain a complete characterization of complete multipartite graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1; the general characterization problem is reported as hard (no good characterization unless P = NP ∩ co-NP). Status of this specific question is unclear from available sources.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems concerning quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Several new infinite families of graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1 are constructed; no good characterization unless P = NP ∩ co-NP.
status_evidence.claim: The general problem of characterizing graphs with ψ_q(G)=1 is hard, and only partial families are known.

status_evidence.title: Quorum coloring of maximum cardinality in linear time
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) and gives algorithms for special graph classes.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work focuses on algorithms rather than characterizing complete multipartite graphs with ψ_q=1.

status_evidence.title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Open question 3 asks for complete multipartite graphs with ψ_q(G) = 1 other than those of Corollary 4.2.
status_evidence.claim: This particular question on complete multipartite graphs is explicitly listed as open.
